title: Dental Office Scheduler - Treatment Coordinator
description:
Unlock your potential at Dental Design of Arcadia as a full- or part-time Dental Office Scheduler - Treatment Coordinator! Join our exceptional team and become an integral part of creating unforgettable smiles. Are you ready for a fulfilling career where you'll enjoy a competitive wage of $20-25 per hour, along with comprehensive benefits like medical, vision, life, in-house dental, paid time off (PTO), holiday pay, and uniforms? Embrace this opportunity to make a lasting impact on our patients' lives while advancing your professional journey.


WHAT DENTAL DESIGN OF ARCADIA IS ALL ABOUT

For many people, going to the dentist can be an intimidating and anxiety-inducing experience. Our compassionate team at Dental Design of Arcadia is determined to change that. At our dentistry practice, we treat our patients like individuals, not just numbers on a chart. We are committed to providing patients of all ages with high-quality care while making them feel at ease and comfortable. With a winning combination of an incredible team and cutting-edge technology, we are proud to serve our patients and bring more smiles to our community!

Our practice's success stems from our friendly and talented employees. We are more than just a team here; we are a family. Our team members are truly passionate about what they do and take pride in helping others. To thank them for all they do, we offer our employees great wages, awesome benefits, and a warm, supportive work environment.


A DAY IN THE LIFE AS A DENTAL OFFICE SCHEDULER - TREATMENT COORDINATOR:

Step into our modern dental practice, where every day is an opportunity to orchestrate seamless dental experiences. As a Dental Office Scheduler - Treatment Coordinator at Dental Design of Arcadia, you'll be at the heart of our operation. Picture yourself as the maestro of our schedule, orchestrating appointments and ensuring our patients receive the highest quality care precisely when they need it.

In addition to your scheduling prowess, you'll play a pivotal role in creating treatment plans tailored to our patients' unique needs. By engaging with warmth and expertise, you'll guide them through the process, answering questions, and making sure they feel comfortable and confident in their decisions. Your attention to detail will ensure accurate record-keeping and adherence to privacy regulations, allowing our dental team to deliver exceptional care efficiently.


QUALIFICATIONS

To thrive as a Dental Office Scheduler - Treatment Coordinator with Dental Design of Arcadia, we seek candidates who meet the following minimum requirements:

  • At least 1 year of dental industry experience, which will enable you to effectively communicate treatment plans and engage patients with empathy and care
  • A warm and professional demeanor, with excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Exceptional organizational abilities, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain accurate records

SCHEDULE & LOCATION

Enjoy the perfect work-life balance as a full-time Dental Office Scheduler - Treatment Coordinator. Immerse yourself in our dental world from Monday to Thursday, with convenient working hours of 7:00 am to 5:00 pm. Dental Design of Arcadia is nestled in the vibrant community of Phoenix, AZ, specifically located in the 85018 area code. Join us in our modern and inviting office, where you'll be surrounded by a supportive and collaborative team.


ARE YOU READY TO JOIN OUR TEAM?

Are you excited to be the mastermind behind our schedule and an integral part of creating dazzling smiles? Take the next step toward this fulfilling career by applying today! Our application process is quick and hassle-free. We hope to meet you soon!

title: Digital Workplace Engineer (SharePoint & Power Platform)
description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Support the assessment and migration of sites, documents, metadata, permissions and workflows from SG-DCS, SharePoint 2013 and other legacy environments to SharePoint Online.

2. Use migration tools such as ShareGate or Microsoft Migration Manager to run migration jobs, review results, correct errors and validate migrated content.

3. Configure and maintain SharePoint Online sites, document libraries, lists, metadata, views, navigation and permissions.

4. Build and enhance Power Apps and Power Automate workflows for straight forward business processes and productivity needs.

5. Develop or modify lightweight SharePoint components and integrations using SPFx, JavaScript or TypeScript where required.

6. Assist with discovery workshops, content inventories, migration mapping, testing, cutover preparation and post-migration support.

7. Troubleshoot migration, access, workflow and application issues, escalating complex problems when necessary.

8. Prepare clear technical documentation, test scripts, user guides and migration status updates.

9. Work directly with users to validate migrated content, gather feedback and make iterative improvements.

10. Learnand apply relevant Microsoft 365, Power Platform and development practices with guidance from more experienced team members.

Required Skills and Experience

1. 2–3years of hands-on experience developing or supporting SharePoint, Microsoft 365or Power Platform solutions.

2. Practical experience with SharePoint Online sites, document libraries, lists, metadata, permissions and basic administration.

3. Some hands-on exposure to SharePoint migration, including content assessment, migration execution, validation or issue remediation.

4. Experience with ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager or a similar migration tool is preferred; candidates with relevant migration fundamentals and a willingness to learn may also be considered.

5. Hands-on experience building or maintaining Power Apps and Power Automate workflows.

6. Basic development skills in JavaScript or TypeScript; exposure to SPFx, React, Microsoft Graph or REST APIs is useful but not mandatory across all areas.

7. Ability to troubleshoot systematically, test changes carefully and produce clear technical and user documentation.
1. Ability to work with business users and technical team members to clarify requirements and deliver practical solutions.

2. Familiarity with source control and basic development practices is helpful; deep expertise in Azure architecture, CI/CD or enterprise integration is not required.

3. A proactive, hands-on attitude, willingness to learn and ability to take guidance, own assigned work and improve through feedback.

Preferred Skills

1. Exposure to SharePoint 2013, SharePoint Server, SG-DCS or other legacy collaboration platforms.

2. Experience supporting user acceptance testing, migration cutovers or post-migration hypercare.

3. Familiarity with Microsoft Lists, Forms, Dataverse, Power BI or Microsoft 365 Copilot.

4. Basic awareness of records management, retention, access control and information governance.

5. Experience working in government, regulated or security-conscious environments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a practical, hands-on developer with 2–3 years of relevant experience and a strong interest in SharePoint migration and Power Platform delivery. They should be comfortable working through assigned migration tasks, building straightforward apps and workflows, troubleshooting issues, engaging users and learning unfamiliar tools or techniques. Broad expertise across Azure services, enterprise architecture and CI/CD is not expected for this role.

title: Lead Consultant
description:
Job Description

· We are looking for an AI Engineer with strong expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Google Cloud and AI-powered User Experience (UX) to design, develop and deliver scalable enterprise AI solutions.

· AI/ML Engineering & Solution Development Design, develop and support scalable and optimised AI/ML solutions for enterprise use cases.

· Develop and implement AI/ML algorithms and solutions based on business and user requirements.

· Build data processing workflows for extracting, transforming and loading large volumes of structured and unstructured data.

· Prepare, integrate and transform data required for AI/ML model development and deployment.

· Work with Data Scientists and ML Engineers to convert analytical and theoretical models into production-ready AI solutions.

· Conduct experiments to evaluate model performance, accuracy, scalability and reliability.

· Identify, troubleshoot and resolve issues affecting deployed AI/ML solutions.

· Apply statistics, scripting and programming skills to develop and optimise AI solutions.

· Integrate Google AI APIs for use cases including Natural Language, Vision, Speech, Search and Recommendations.

· Evaluate and experiment with emerging Google AI capabilities and translate them into practical enterprise solutions.

· Balance custom AI/ML development with managed Google Cloud services based on performance, scalability, cost and business requirements.

· MLOps & Model Lifecycle Support model training, validation, deployment, monitoring and lifecycle management.

· Implement appropriate MLOps practices for model versioning, deployment and monitoring.

· Monitor deployed models and identify opportunities for performance optimisation.

· Support continuous improvement of AI/ML solutions based on model performance and user feedback.

· Ensure AI solutions are scalable, reliable and suitable for enterprise production environments.

· AI/UX & User Experience Design AI-powered experiences that translate complex AI capabilities and model outputs into intuitive user interactions.

· Work with UX teams to integrate AI capabilities across web, mobile, conversational interfaces, dashboards and enterprise applications.

· Design interfaces that allow users to understand, validate and act on AI-generated insights.

· Develop explainable and transparent AI experiences that improve user trust and adoption.

· Design human-in-the-loop workflows where users can review, challenge and provide feedback on AI outputs.

· Contribute to user research, journey mapping, prototyping and usability testing for AI-powered products. Translate user needs and business requirements into practical AI solution designs.

· Data, Analytics & AI Insights Work with Data Scientists, Data Engineers and Analytics teams to prepare and utilise data for AI solutions.

· Analyse complex datasets and AI outputs to identify actionable business insights.

· Define and track AI solution KPIs including model performance, adoption, accuracy, user engagement and business impact.

· Support experimentation and A/B testing to evaluate AI features and user experiences.

· Assess data quality, bias and representativeness to support reliable AI outcomes.

· Identify and address risks relating to bias, fairness, privacy, security, transparency and explainability.

· Support responsible use of enterprise data in AI/ML solutions.

· Ensure AI solutions align with applicable data protection, security and regulatory requirements.

· Promote transparent and human-centred AI design practices.

· Stakeholder & Client Collaboration Collaborate with Product Managers, UX Designers, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Cloud Architects and business stakeholders.

· Translate business requirements into technical AI/ML solutions and user-centric experiences.

· Lead technical discussions, AI solution workshops and design-thinking sessions with stakeholders.

· Communicate AI concepts, model outputs and technical considerations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

· Support client engagements, solution proposals, proof-of-concepts and AI transformation initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience

· 3+ years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, AI solution development or related AI engineering roles.

· Strong hands-on experience developing and deploying AI/ML solutions.

· Experience with data extraction, transformation, integration and processing for AI/ML applications.

· Strong programming/scripting skills in Python or equivalent programming languages.

· Strong understanding of machine learning, statistics, algorithms and model evaluation.

· Experience working with Generative AI, LLMs, embeddings and conversational AI.

· Hands-on experience with Google Cloud AI / Vertex AI or comparable enterprise AI/ML platforms.

· Experience with BigQuery, cloud data pipelines and analytics platforms.

· Understanding of MLOps, including model training, deployment, monitoring, versioning and lifecycle management.

· Experience troubleshooting and optimising deployed AI/ML models.

· Experience designing or contributing to AI-powered UX and enterprise digital experiences.

title: Product Owner (Matchmaking&Relationship)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Owner (Matchmaking & Relationship) based in India.

This role owns the post-purchase product experience, with a direct focus on helping paying customers reach meaningful value quickly. You’ll take end-to-end ownership of activation, matching, relevance, and engagement, from initial hypotheses through measurable results. The role combines product strategy, experimentation, customer journey design, personalization, and recommendation systems. You’ll identify bottlenecks and growth opportunities through data, research, and customer insights, then translate them into focused product improvements. Working closely with engineers, designers, analysts, and data specialists, you’ll move ideas into production and continuously iterate based on results. This is an opportunity to shape a discovery-driven product where matching quality and customer experience are central to product success.

Accountabilities:

  • Own the post-purchase customer journey, focusing on helping paying customers reach a quality match as quickly as possible.
  • Optimize offer volume and presentation so customers receive an appropriate number of relevant options without being overwhelmed or underserved.
  • Improve recommendation relevance and customer trust in the options presented throughout the experience.
  • Increase the volume and quality of relevant invitations received by paying customers.
  • Improve the likelihood that new customers form a quality match during their first week.
  • Design engagement mechanics such as gamification, nudges, reminders, and conversation reactivation features that encourage customers to return.
  • Analyze matching parameters across user segments and use segmentation, personalization, and data enrichment to improve discovery and matching outcomes.
  • Identify bottlenecks and growth opportunities in the post-purchase journey using quantitative data, qualitative research, and product insight.
  • Translate opportunities into clear, testable hypotheses with defined success metrics and requirements.
  • Collaborate with engineers, designers, analysts, and data/ML specialists to deliver product improvements efficiently.
  • Manage requirements, priorities, and timelines while maintaining predictable delivery.
  • Run A/B tests and other experiments, analyze product metrics and outcomes, and scale improvements that demonstrate meaningful results.

    • Requirements:

    • Hands-on B2C product management experience, particularly in customer experience, customer journey design, activation, onboarding, or first-session experiences.
    • Experience working with discovery-driven products involving large volumes of offers, listings, or potential matches.
    • Practical understanding of search or feed relevance, matching, recommendation systems, segmentation, personalization, and data-enriched offers.
    • Experience in marketplaces, aggregators, dating or social discovery, real estate, classifieds, e-commerce with large catalogs, or other discovery and recommendation-focused products is highly relevant.
    • Strong ability to formulate product hypotheses, define clear requirements, and connect product initiatives to measurable outcomes.
    • Experience driving product delivery from concept through launch and iteration.
    • Practical knowledge of A/B testing and experimentation, including defining success metrics and validating results.
    • Comfortable combining qualitative and quantitative product research to identify customer needs and growth opportunities.
    • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with designers, analysts, engineers, and data specialists.
    • Strong understanding of product metrics and the ability to identify opportunities for growth and improvement.
    • Results-oriented mindset focused on measurable impact rather than process for its own sake.
    • High level of ownership, initiative, and comfort working with changing priorities.
    • Clear, direct communication skills and the ability to make decisions in an evolving environment.
    • Ability to treat unsuccessful experiments as opportunities for learning and iteration.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote, full-time opportunity.
      • Initial compensation level or salary range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins.
      • 28 calendar days of vacation per year.
      • 7 wellness days per year for personal needs, rest, or recovery.
      • Referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful candidate recommendations.
      • 50% coverage for professional training, international conferences, and professional meetings.
      • Corporate discounts for English-language lessons.
      • Health support of up to $1,000 gross per year per employee when corporate medical insurance is not available, which can be used toward private health insurance or eligible medical expenses for the employee and close relatives.

title: Engineering Manager II - Platform Backend
description:
About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

About the Role:

We're looking for an experienced Engineering Manager II to lead engineering for our Platform Services team - the team responsible for the shared infrastructure, internal tooling, and core services that other product teams build on. This is not a purely managerial role; you'll stay hands-on with architecture, code, and systems while owning team outcomes, delivery, and platform reliability at enterprise scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Scale: Own and evolve distributed systems architecture for platform services, ensuring they're reliable, extensible, and performant under enterprise-scale load.
  • Cost & Efficiency: Drive continuous cost optimization initiatives across cloud infrastructure without compromising reliability or performance - with measurable, sustained impact.
  • Execution & Delivery: Own roadmap planning, estimation, and predictable delivery for the platform team, balancing tech debt, new capabilities, and operational stability.
  • Reliability & Operations: Establish strong observability and incident management practices; ensure the team can detect, diagnose, and resolve issues quickly, and drive blameless postmortems that lead to real fixes.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Use metrics and data to prioritize, evaluate trade-offs, and report on platform health, cost, and team performance.
  • People & Culture: Hire, mentor, and grow engineers; set technical standards; build a culture of ownership and craftsmanship within the team.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product engineering teams, SRE/infra, security, and leadership to align platform capabilities with organizational needs.
  • Communication: Represent the platform team's priorities, risks, and progress clearly to engineering leadership and stakeholders across the org.

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including at least 2+ years in a Software Development Manager (or equivalent) role.
  • Expert-level proficiency in either Go, Python or Nodejs.
  • Prior experience managing a platform team, or having worked as an individual contributor on platform teams for at least 3+ years, at enterprise scale.
  • Strong hands-on orientation - comfortable reviewing code, debugging production issues, and going deep on architecture, not just managing processes. Candidates in a purely managerial (non-hands-on) role for the last 1+ year will not be considered a fit.
  • Deep, practical experience with GCP and/or AWS service management - provisioning, scaling, IAM, networking, and cost governance.
  • Demonstrated track record of driving cost optimization initiatives in an enterprise cloud environment, with measurable results.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture - consistency, availability, fault tolerance, scaling patterns, and trade-offs at scale.
  • Strong observability fundamentals - hands-on experience with tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, or equivalent, and a track record of building observability into systems from the ground up.
  • A data-driven approach to decision-making, prioritization, and performance reporting.
  • Proven experience in roadmap planning, estimation, and delivering complex initiatives on time.
  • Strong people management skills - hiring, mentoring, performance management - combined with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and security teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • AI-first mindset - actively using AI tools in engineering workflows in recent years; experience building or integrating agent-driven systems is a strong plus.

What You'll Lead:

  • A team of platform engineers building and operating shared services, internal platforms, and infrastructure used across multiple product lines.
  • Cloud infrastructure and service management across GCP/AWS, including provisioning, scaling, security, and cost governance.
  • Observability strategy - metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting - so the org has clear visibility into system health and performance.
  • Adoption of AI-driven engineering practices, including exploring agentic workflows and AI-assisted tooling to improve developer velocity and platform automation.

title: Tech/E-commerce - Partnerships Operations Manager (Data Analyst)

Location: Raffles Place, Singapore
Contract: 12 months
Salary: S$6,000 – S$8,000 per month

A leading global technology company is seeking a Partnerships Operations Manager to drive performance visibility and operational excellence across its product partnerships ecosystem.

This role sits at the center of cross-functional teams, owning the data and reporting cadence that keeps the partnerships organization accountable to its goals. You will translate performance data into actionable insights that help shape partnership strategy, improve operational efficiency, and support business growth.

Address: 1735 Mission Street San Francisco, CA 94103
Reports To: Mental Health Director

Organization Mission

The mission of Lyon-Martin Community Health Services is to provide high quality, compassionate and trauma-informed medical, gynecological, and mental health care services to trans, non-binary, gender non-conforming, and intersex communities and cis-gender women with specific sensitivity to LGBQA sexual orientation, disability, size, race, ethnicity, and language, regardless of immigration status or ability to pay.

We aim to address and eliminate health inequities for our communities by rooting our clinical practice in core foundational intersectional frameworks of anti-racism, self-determination, harm reduction, and reproductive and disability justice. As a community clinic, we believe our communities are best served by and for us; that’s why community outreach, engagement, and leadership development are central to our mission of community care and mutual aid. Lastly, we commit to increasing access to culturally responsive care beyond our walls through provider training and education, and policy advocacy.

Job Summary

Lyon-Martin Therapists are responsible for providing clinically appropriate outpatient mental health and co-occurring substance use disorder services to Lyon-Martin clients. As a specialist in queer, trans, and intersex (QTI) care, Lyon-Martin therapists are expected to have experience and a commitment to LBGTQIA+ community health care.

Therapists are expected to primarily provide psychotherapy services. However, in addition to therapy, the Therapist may also provide crisis intervention, brief behavioral interventions, psychosocial assessments for gender affirming surgery, group psychotherapy, appropriate internal/external referrals, and clinical case management. Therapists are expected to maintain a high degree of professional competence, the highest possible ethical standards, and the ability to work collaboratively as part of an integrated health care team. This position may be required to work some evenings.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Care Responsibilities

  • Under the supervision of the Mental Health Director, evaluates, diagnoses, and treats mental health/substance use disorders within individual client sessions.
  • Demonstrates strong clinical knowledge of and commitment to healthcare for trans and gender non-conforming people, LGBTQIA+ communities, and cis-gender women.
  • Completes gender affirming procedure assessments and writes letters of support for insurance and surgeon approval in a timely manner.
  • De-escalates clients in mental health emergencies or high emotional distress.
  • Facilitates group therapy to foster safety, consistency, and socialization.
  • Utilizes appropriate referral and collateral sources to best support each client.
  • Maintains appropriate boundaries with clients, especially when experiencing countertransference.
  • May do some clinical case management, assisting with accessing benefits or support services.
  • Attends weekly mental health team meetings, weekly one-on-one supervision meetings with Mental Health Director, monthly Collaborative Care meetings.
  • Reserves one appointment per week for gender affirming letter assessments.
  • Facilitates one group per week.

Performance and Quality Improvement Responsibilities:

  • Meets benchmarks for applicable visit numbers and quality indicators as assigned (expectation is 3 scheduled visits per half day).
  • Completes letters of support for surgery within 1 month after assessment is complete.
  • Responds to in basket messages within 72 hours; Closes visit notes within 72 hours.
  • Strong initiative and enthusiasm and willingness to pitch in whenever needed.
  • Along with colleagues, assists in continuous quality improvement through on-going problem/needs identification and problem solving and, as requested, acts as a champion of change and a leader for improvement activities.

And, other duties as assigned.

Competencies:

  • Mission-driven: demonstrates commitment to mission of the organization, queer, intersex and trans health, and community-driven primary care.
  • Teamwork: reaches out to peers and cooperates with supervisors to establish an overall collaborative working relationship; treats everyone with dignity regardless of their level or background. Accountable to team; participates effectively in group- and teamwork; collaborates positively with other team members; giving and accepting constructive criticism.
  • Communication: Delivers written communications that have clarity and impact including emails. Effective listener; clearly and thoughtfully communicates with others in person and on the phone.
  • Strives to understand the viewpoints of others. Maintains professionalism in all communications. Asks for support when needed.
  • Reliability: Accountable; maintains focus; punctual; good attendance record; meets deadlines.
  • Customer Service: Persists in efforts to solve issues even when faced with internal barriers; accountable to outcomes; responds quickly and effectively to requests for assistance and support whether internal or external; asks questions when unsure of the answer.
  • Computer Literacy: Skilled computer-based work tasks; uses technology to enhance job performance. MS Office, Excel, Word and/or PowerPoint.
  • Tolerance for Stress, Ambiguity, and Change: Maintains composure while under pressure; handles complex problems and change with grace; demonstrates flexibility and versatility in achieving key goals and priorities.
  • Attention to Detail: Strives to eliminate errors; makes accurate work a priority; seeks opportunities to improve performance.
  • Decision Making: Collects, organizes, and analyzes information before making decisions. Takes a thoughtful approach when considering options; may seek supervision and/or input from others.
  • Integrity and Ethics: Actively models the highest ethical standards; is honest and accountable; maintains confidentiality and appropriate boundaries at all times; handles sensitive information and issues with discretion and tact.
  • Presentation Skills: Adapts presentation techniques to fit audience level and technical needs; develops and delivers communications that have clarity and impact; conveys confidence, presence, and professionalism; uses appropriate visual aids to illustrate key points and enhance learning.
  • Accountability: Makes and meets commitments; accepts responsibility for behavior and outcomes.
  • Follow Through: Monitors status of projects and tasks; thoroughly deals with project details; delivers clear, accurate depiction of status.
  • Cultural Humility and Sensitivity: Ability to work with a diverse population while withholding judgment. Willingly open to learn and understand different perspectives.
  • Intelligence: learns quickly; demonstrates ability to proficiently understand and absorb new information
  • Creativity/innovation: generates new and innovative approaches to problems.
  • Enthusiasm: exhibits passion and excitement over work; has a can-do attitude
  • Work ethic: possesses a strong willingness to work hard to get the job done.

Education, Knowledge, Skills:

Required:

  • Graduation from an accredited school of social work, marriage & family therapy, licensed professional clinical counseling program with a master’s degree or a school of psychology with a PsyD. or PhD.
  • Licensing Requirements: *Associate Therapists: Licensed in California as an ASW, AMFT or RPA; Licensed Therapists: California license as an LCSW, LMFT, LPCC or Psychologist.
  • Culturally sensitive/humble and able to work with a diverse population
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, specifically Word, Outlook, internet applications, zoom, computer technology, and phone use
  • Experience working with lesbian, bisexual, transgender, gender non-conforming, non-binary, and intersex communities.
  • Experience working with populations with varying disabilities, racial, ethnic and cultural backgrounds and economic statuses.
  • Experience working with people who do sex work, those experiencing homelessness, people who have challenges with mentally illness and/or using drugs, those of with a history of incarceration, people of varying ages.
  • An interest in and commitment to gender affirming health care and health care access for underserved populations.

Preferred:

  • Bilingual Spanish/English fluency; other bilingual or multilingual fluency
  • EMDR training; DBT training; CBT training

title: Senior Research Fellow (Computational Electromagnetism and Nanophotonics)
description:
School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering is one of the founding Schools of the Nanyang Technological University. Built on a culture of excellence, the School is renowned for its high academic standards and research. With over 3,000 undergraduates students and 2,000 graduate students it is one of the largest EEE schools in the world and ranks 4th in the field of Electrical & Electronic Engineering in the 2025 QS World University Rankings by Subjects.


Today, the School has become one of the world’s largest engineering schools that nurtures competent engineers and researchers. Each year, the School graduates over a thousand students who are ready to take on great ambitions and challenges.


For more details, please view: https://www.ntu.edu.sg/eee


We are seeking a Senior Research Fellow (SRF) who is highly skilled in and deeply passionate about computational electromagnetism and mathematical physics/engineering. The SRF should have strong background in computational methods for solving Maxwell’s equations – strong foundations in quantum electrodynamics (QED) are a significant bonus. The role of SRF will focus on developing ab initio theory and developing software to describe and study groundbreaking mechanisms in electron-photon and electron-matter interaction, pertaining to the compact, efficient generation of extreme ultraviolet light for applications including EUV spectroscopy and EUV nanolithography.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Computationally solve electrodynamics problems involving electron-photon and electron-matter interactions in the extreme ultraviolet (EUV) regime
  • Develop new, efficient software for modeling unprecedented electromagnetic phenomena, using languages such as C++ and Python
  • Formulate new theories pertaining to EUV generation, obtained ab initio from Maxwell’s equations and quantum electrodynamics/quantum field theory
  • Lead papers and publish in high-impact journals
  • Present at top-tier international conferences.
  • Assist PI in writing grants and supervision of graduate and undergraduate students.
  • Provide logistical support pertaining to laboratory operation for the project.

  • PhD degree in physics, mathematics, engineering or related field
  • Strong background in electrodynamics simulations techniques
  • Strong background in C++, Python or similar languages
  • Strong background in theoretical physics and mathematical physics
  • Good written and oral communication skills
  • Proficiency in nanofabrication and experimental design
  • Interpersonal skill: Ability to work under pressure, Ability to work independently, develop solutions under strict timelines, meticulous and eye for details, excellent organizational / time management skills

title: Software Product Manager
description:
The Opportunity

Hioki is looking for an experienced Product Manager to lead the GENNECT series of software and apps. You’ll help define not only the future of the GENNECT ecosystem, but how software becomes a core part of Hioki’s customer value proposition.

Hioki has built its reputation through trusted electrical measurement instruments. Our next stage of growth is about creating more value beyond the instrument by connecting instruments, measurement data, workflows and users through software.

We want a Product Manager who will treat these products as their business and their products — not a roadmap or backlog to administer. You will develop the strategy, frame the priorities and build the case — working closely enough with engineers and designers to visibly shape the product.

Day to day, you will define product direction, understand customer workflows, identify unmet needs and work closely with engineering, UX, marketing and our Japan headquarters to bring better software experiences to market.

This role is based in Singapore and works extensively with teams in Japan and across Hioki globally. If you want to build products where hardware, software, data and real-world engineering come together, we would like to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities

Product Vision & Strategy

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for GENNECT series of software and apps.
  • Define target users, use cases, key problems and differentiated value propositions.
  • Shape how future applications fit within the wider Hioki software and connected-instrument ecosystem.
  • Translate Hioki’s hardware strengths into software-enabled workflows and services.
  • Make clear prioritisation decisions on what to build, improve or stop.

Customer & Market Understanding

  • Develop deep understanding of customer measurement, data management, reporting and collaboration workflows.
  • Engage directly with customers, application engineers and sales teams to identify pain points and opportunities.
  • Analyse competing software platforms and emerging market expectations.
  • Convert customer insight into product priorities and validate ideas quickly before major development investment.

Product Development

  • Work hands-on with engineering and UX/UI teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Create user flows, wireframes and prototypes to communicate ideas clearly.
  • Participate in architecture and technical discussions and understand key trade-offs.
  • Review features during development and help set the quality bar before release.
  • Drive Agile development with a strong bias toward learning, iteration and speed.

AI-Native Product Management

AI should be part of how this Product Manager works every day — not to replace software engineers, but to help the PM think, test and learn faster.

  • Use AI for research, competitive analysis, specifications, communication and product thinking.
  • Use AI-assisted prototyping or coding tools to rapidly test ideas and user journeys.
  • Identify opportunities to incorporate AI into GENNECT products where it creates genuine customer value.
  • Help establish modern, AI-enabled product development practices.

Commercial & Lifecycle Ownership

  • Take responsibility for business performance, not only product delivery.
  • Define launch, adoption and product performance KPIs.
  • Work with Product Marketing and Sales on positioning, packaging, pricing and adoption.
  • Track product usage, customer feedback and commercial results after launch.
  • Manage the full lifecycle, including upgrades and eventual transition or retirement.

Global Collaboration

  • Act as a bridge between customers, global markets, Singapore teams and Hioki headquarters in Japan.
  • Communicate product direction and priorities clearly across functions and cultures.
  • Work closely with Product Marketing, Forward Deployment Engineers, Sales and Hioki’s Centers of Excellence to bring strong Voice of Customer into development.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Product Design, Business or related discipline.
  • Around 7+ years of product management or related product development experience, including meaningful software experience.
  • Demonstrated ownership of products from concept through launch and improvement.
  • Strong product judgement and ability to make difficult prioritisation decisions.
  • Good understanding of software development and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Sufficient technical understanding to engage engineers on architecture, APIs, data, cloud services and technical trade-offs.
  • Strong UX sensibility and ability to communicate ideas through wireframes or prototypes.
  • Strong analytical and customer-centric mindset.
  • Ability to create clarity in ambiguous environments.
  • Strong cross-functional and cross-cultural communication skills.
  • Comfortable working closely with Japan-based teams (in English).
  • Active user of modern AI tools for research, analysis, writing or prototyping.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in industrial software, connected instruments, IoT or data acquisition.
  • Experience with software used by engineers or technical professionals.
  • Experience in B2B or enterprise software.
  • Exposure to manufacturing, energy, mobility or maintenance markets.
  • Experience integrating software with physical hardware or instruments.
  • Familiarity with Figma and AI prototyping tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, v0 or Replit.

About Hioki

Hioki is a global leader in the design, manufacturing, and sales of high-precision electrical test and measurement instruments. Our solutions support a wide range of industries, including automotive, electronic components, infrastructure, environmental systems, renewable energy, and battery technologies.

With a strong heritage of innovation and quality, Hioki continues to advance measurement technologies that enable safer, more efficient, and more sustainable industrial development worldwide.

title: Pet Nutritionist
description:
We are looking for a Nutritionist to join BOM BOM, supporting personalised pet nutrition, nutritional data analysis and new product development. In this role, you will provide tailored dietary recommendations for pets, maintain our nutritional database and SOPs, and contribute to the development and improvement of our pet food products. You will work closely with our Customer Solutions, Operations and Marketing teams to ensure our nutritional recommendations and products are accurate, practical and aligned with established nutritional standards. You will also play a role in improving our Nutrition BOM BOT AI system by reviewing nutritional information, analysing customer insights and enhancing the accuracy of its recommendations. If you have a strong foundation in animal nutrition, enjoy working with data and product development, and are a pet owner who is genuinely passionate about pet health and nutrition, we’d love for you to join us!

Responsibilities

Pet Nutrition & Dietary Recommendations

  • Provide personalised dietary recommendations based on pets' nutritional requirements, life stages, health conditions and individual needs.
  • Review pet profiles and nutritional information to recommend suitable products and feeding plans.
  • Support the Customer Solutions team with nutrition-related enquiries that require specialised knowledge.
  • Review and update dietary recommendations based on new nutritional findings, product changes and customer feedback.
  • Escalate complex medical or veterinary-related cases to the appropriate specialists.

Nutritional Database & Analysis

  • Maintain and update nutritional databases, ingredient information and product specifications.
  • Analyse nutritional data to support dietary recommendations and product development.
  • Review nutritional calculations and ensure consistency and accuracy across products and feeding recommendations.
  • Support the ongoing improvement of Nutrition BOM BOT by reviewing its nutritional knowledge base and identifying gaps or inaccuracies.

SOP Maintenance& Documentation

  • Maintain and update nutrition-related SOPs, formulation records and technical documentation.
  • Ensure nutritional information and internal guidelines remain accurate, consistent and up to date.
  • Work with relevant departments to review and improve existing nutrition-related processes.
  • Maintain proper records of product formulations, nutritional calculations and supporting documentation.

New Product Development (NPD)

  • Support the research, formulation and development of new pet food products.
  • Evaluate ingredients based on nutritional value, suitability and product requirements.
  • Conduct nutritional calculations and review formulations against established standards, including NRC, AAFCO and FEDIAF.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Procurement and external laboratories on ingredient testing, product trials and nutritional analysis.
  • Review existing products and recommend improvements based on nutritional findings, customer feedback and market trends.
  • Assist with product specifications, nutritional labelling and technical documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Customer Solutions to ensure dietary recommendations and nutritional information are communicated accurately.
  • Collaborate with Operations and Procurement on ingredient suitability, product specifications and formulation requirements.
  • Provide technical nutritional information to support Marketing's product content and claims.
  • Work with internal stakeholders to improve nutritional processes and product offerings.

Requirements

  • Degree in Animal Science, Animal Nutrition, Food Science, Nutrition or a related discipline.
  • Preferably 2–4 years of relevant experience in pet nutrition, food formulation, product development or a related field.
  • Good understanding of companion animal nutrition, particularly dogs and cats.
  • Familiarity with NRC, AAFCO and FEDIAF nutritional guidelines.
  • Knowledge of nutritional calculations, ingredient functionality and dietary formulation.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, with the ability to analyse and maintain nutritional data.
  • Good documentation, organisational and communication skills.
  • Able to work independently and collaborate with different departments.
  • Detail-oriented, with an interest in product development and continuous improvement.
  • Genuine interest in pet health, nutrition and animal welfare.

This is an opportunity to join a small, senior design team shaping a fast-moving B2B platform built for engineers and technical teams working with AI-assisted software development. You will own complex product problems across coding agents, developer tooling, desktop experiences, and infrastructure and spend management interfaces. The role combines end-to-end product design, independent user research, product strategy, and hands-on prototyping. You will work closely with engineers and other designers, bringing a strong point of view while navigating ambiguity and technical constraints. AI-assisted development is an important part of the workflow, with opportunities to prototype directly in code rather than relying solely on traditional design tools. In a remote-first international environment, your work will directly influence how technical teams build, manage, and scale AI-powered development workflows.

  • Collaborate with engineers and other designers to develop solutions that balance user experience, technical constraints, architecture, and business objectives.
  • Participate in cross-team design reviews to identify overlap, maintain consistency, raise the quality bar, and stay aligned with broader product initiatives.
  • Monitor design debt within your area and advocate for improvements when usability risks, technical constraints, or user feedback make them a priority.

    • Requirements:

title: Senior Global Mobility Specialist
description:
About RemotePass
RemotePass is a global employment, payroll, and spend platform that helps companies hire, pay, and support talent in 150+ countries. Recognised as one of G2's Top 100 Fastest Growing Software Products, we're on a mission to break down geographical barriers and create a world where exceptional talent can thrive anywhere.

From hiring and onboarding to payroll, compliance, and financial services, we give organisations everything they need to build high-performing global teams, and give workers worldwide access to opportunities that were once out of reach.

We're backed by world-class investors including EBRD Venture Capital, 500 Global, Endeavor Catalyst, BECO Capital, Wamda Capital, 212 VC, Oraseya Capital, Khwarizmi Ventures, and Access Bridge Ventures.

About the Role
RemotePass supports workers in more than 150 countries, and immigration is one of the most complex parts of making that work. We're hiring a Senior Global Mobility Specialist to own our most complex, highest-risk immigration cases end to end and be the go-to expert for the wider Mobility team.

You'll run your own caseload of work permits, visas, extensions, and status changes. You'll also be the escalation point when cases get complicated, and the mentor junior specialists turn to for a steer. You'll work closely with Legal, HR, Payroll, and Talent Acquisition, as well as external immigration counsel and government agencies worldwide.

This isn't a legal role, but it does demand real depth. You'll need hands-on immigration compliance experience across multiple jurisdictions and the confidence to bring structure to ambiguous, high-pressure cases.

What You'll Do

  • Own complex cases. Manage work permits, visas, extensions, renewals, status changes, and immigration assessments end to end, with a focus on complex and high-risk cases. Track expiry dates and start renewals early so nothing lapses.
  • Be the escalation point. Handle escalations from employees, managers, and external providers. Advise the Onboarding, Offboarding, and Lifecycle teams on eligibility, documentation, and compliance for hires, transfers, and relocations.
  • Lead compliance and risk. Keep our immigration processes compliant with global, regional, and local rules. Spot risks and delays across the caseload early, monitor policy changes, and brief leadership on what they mean.
  • Own the immigration knowledge base. Keep country requirements, processing times, and procedures accurate, validating them with external counsel and government agencies. Turn that knowledge into clear guidance for internal teams and employees.
  • Mentor and build relationships. Review and coach Junior Global Mobility Specialists, and support the Lifecycle team during peak periods. Build strong relationships with external counsel, vendors, and government representatives.
  • Improve how we work. Track processing times, approval rates, and bottlenecks across regions. Design process improvements that make mobility faster, more compliant, and easier for employees.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 4–6 years managing complex, cross-border immigration cases, ideally at an EOR, global mobility firm, immigration consultancy, or in-house mobility function.
  • Strong working knowledge of immigration compliance and cross-border workforce requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience managing external immigration counsel and working with government agencies internationally.
  • Experience mentoring junior team members or reviewing their work.
  • Practical understanding of data privacy as it applies to employee immigration records.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, fully remote, high-growth environment.
  • Fluent in English. Another language is a plus.

You'll Thrive in This Role If

  • You like owning complex, ambiguous cases with minimal oversight.
  • You can turn complex immigration rules into plain guidance for non-experts.
  • You spot risk before it becomes a problem.
  • You'd rather improve a process than just follow it.

Benefits

Why Join RemotePass?

  • Be the senior immigration expert for a workforce spanning 150+ countries, with a real say in mobility strategy and process.
  • Mentor junior specialists and help shape how a growing team works.
  • Profitable, and still scaling fast. We reached profitability in 2025 and just raised a $17.4M Series B led by EBRD, with 500 Global joining. You get the pace of a scale-up with the stability of a business that works.
  • Real global scale. We support 35,000+ workers in 150+ countries and have processed over $800M in cross-border payroll for companies like Logitech, Tata Group, and Careem.
  • Big bets ahead. We're expanding across Europe and the US, building financial products for distributed teams, and investing heavily in AI. There's a lot to build, and room to grow with it.
  • Remote-first, for real. We don't just sell remote work, we live it. Work from anywhere.
  • Inclusion matters. We value different perspectives and empower everyone to bring their authentic self to work.

    • Experience with, or a strong interest in learning about, SMTP, MTAs, DNS, bounces, deferrals, IP pools, and mailbox-provider behavior.

    • Strong focus on reliability, observability, operational excellence, and minimizing the potential impact of incidents.

title: Backend Engineer, MTA
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend Engineer, MTA based in Ireland.

This is an opportunity to build and operate the backend infrastructure that powers high-volume email delivery at scale. You’ll work on critical systems spanning SMTP delivery, routing, retries, throttling, and delivery controls. The role combines backend engineering with the complexities of distributed systems, email infrastructure, and sender reputation. You’ll help create reliable, observable systems that make sending behavior safer and easier to operate. You’ll collaborate closely with Trust & Safety and Core Sending teams while taking significant ownership of technical problems and solutions. The position is fully remote, with flexible working schedules and occasional travel for team off-sites, conferences, and meetups.

Accountabilities:

  • Build, operate, and continuously improve email transport and delivery infrastructure.

  • Develop systems for SMTP delivery, MTA operations, routing, retries, backoff strategies, and delivery controls.

  • Design and maintain throttling mechanisms across domains, providers, customers, and IP addresses.

  • Build infrastructure supporting shared IP pools, dedicated IPs, warmup execution, and reputation-aware routing.

  • Improve the classification and handling of bounces, deferrals, transient failures, hard failures, and other delivery outcomes.

  • Develop internal tools that make delivery issues easier to investigate across customers, domains, mailbox providers, routes, IPs, message types, and events.

  • Design systems that improve the safety, observability, reliability, and operational efficiency of email sending.

  • Translate sender-reputation strategies into robust backend systems and controls.

  • Partner with Trust & Safety and Core Sending teams to protect the sending network from abuse.

  • Participate in incident response for sending, provider, and deliverability-sensitive issues.

  • Take part in on-call responsibilities for critical services.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience in backend engineering.

    • Experience working with email, messaging, notifications, communications infrastructure, or other high-volume delivery systems.

    • Solid understanding of queues, workers, retries, idempotency, rate limits, backpressure, and distributed systems.

    • Experience with, or a strong interest in learning about, SMTP, MTAs, DNS, bounces, deferrals, IP pools, and mailbox-provider behavior.

    • Strong focus on reliability, observability, operational excellence, and minimizing the potential impact of incidents.

    • A high level of ownership, low-ego collaboration, and a preference for simple, maintainable systems.

    • Experience building and operating applications with significant workloads.

    • Familiarity with email best practices, or demonstrated willingness to develop expertise in this area.

    • Experience with TypeScript and/or Go is highly valued.

    • Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment with distributed teammates and flexible schedules.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote position with flexible working schedules.

      • Competitive compensation of $150,000–$170,000 USD, depending on experience.

      • Autonomy and ownership to identify problems, develop solutions, and ship improvements.

      • Opportunity to work with a modern technology stack including TypeScript, AWS, Go, PostgreSQL, and Datadog.

      • Collaborative, honest, and low-ego working environment.

      • Meaningful ownership of critical infrastructure and technical decisions.

      • Opportunities to attend team off-sites, conferences, meetups, and other industry events.

      • Opportunity to work on large-scale email infrastructure used by millions of users.

title: Technical Team Lead
description:
Position Summary

The Technical Team Lead is responsible for the successful execution of network and systems infrastructure projects and for the day-to-day leadership of a five-person engineering team. The role requires a strong network engineering foundation, practical knowledge of servers and VMware virtualisation, and the leadership ability to organise, guide and motivate engineers.

The successful candidate will remain technically credible and involved while ensuring that work is properly planned, assigned, monitored and completed to the required quality, schedule and customer expectations.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning and Execution

• Review project scope, technical requirements, deliverables, timelines and resource needs before implementation begins.

• Develop practical implementation plans, work schedules, task assignments, milestones and escalation paths.

• Allocate work among the three Network Engineers and two Systems Engineers according to their skills, experience, workload and development needs.

• Conduct project kick-off and regular progress meetings, track dependencies and take early action when delivery is at risk.

• Coordinate with the sales, solutions, project, procurement and service teams to ensure smooth project handover and execution.

• Ensure that testing, change control, customer acceptance, documentation and project closure are completed properly.

• Provide clear progress updates to management and promptly escalate major technical, resource, commercial or customer issues.

Technical Leadership

• Provide technical direction and hands-on guidance for network infrastructure projects involving routing, switching, wireless, firewalls, VPNs and related technologies.

• Support the team on systems infrastructure matters, including physical and virtual servers, storage, backup, Microsoft environments and VMware virtualisation.

• Review proposed designs, configurations, implementation plans and troubleshooting approaches to ensure they are secure, supportable and aligned with good engineering practices.

• Lead or support the resolution of complex technical issues and major project escalations.

• Ensure engineers maintain accurate network diagrams, configuration records, implementation documents, test results and handover documentation.

• Promote standard methods, reusable checklists and lessons learned to improve project quality and efficiency.

People and Team Leadership

• Lead the engineering team with clear priorities, consistent communication and a supportive, accountable working environment.

• Set expectations for each engineer, explain the purpose and desired outcome of assigned work, and follow up without unnecessary micromanagement.

• Coach engineers through regular one-to-one discussions, project reviews and constructive feedback.

• Motivate the team by recognising good performance, involving engineers in problem-solving and providing appropriate opportunities to take ownership.

• Understand individual strengths and development gaps, and recommend training, certification, mentoring and project exposure.

• Manage workload fairly, watch for excessive pressure or disengagement, and take practical steps to support team wellbeing and sustained performance.

• Address performance, conduct or teamwork issues early, fairly and professionally, escalating to management when necessary.

• Build cooperation between Network and Systems Engineers and encourage knowledge sharing across both disciplines.

Service Quality and Customer Management

• Maintain professional communication with customers throughout project delivery and manage expectations clearly.

• Ensure work is completed safely, securely and with minimal disruption to customer operations.

• Review customer feedback, recurring incidents and project lessons, then implement improvements with the team.

• Support technical presentations, site surveys, solution validation and presales discussions when required.

Qualifications and Experience

• Diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Network Engineering or a related discipline.

• At least 7 years of relevant infrastructure engineering experience, including several years in a senior engineer, project lead or team lead capacity.

• Strong hands-on experience in enterprise networking, preferably with Cisco or comparable technologies.

• Good working knowledge of server infrastructure and VMware virtualisation; familiarity with Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, storage and backup is advantageous.

• Demonstrated experience planning and delivering infrastructure implementation or migration projects.

• Relevant certifications such as CCNP, VMware VCP, Microsoft or equivalent are advantageous but practical capability and leadership maturity are equally important.

Company and Profile:

Netmarks Singapore is a business-to-business IT solutions provider with over

25 years of experience in the IT industry.

We specialise in IT infrastructure solutioning and focus on helping businesses

identify their pain points through our customer first approach.

We have a strong network of regional offices throughout Southeast Asia and

an affiliation with Biprogy, a listed Japanese systems integrator – which we

leverage on to address customers with regional solutioning needs.

Our clientele ranges from companies in the manufacturing sector to the

automotive industry and we pride ourselves as a trusted IT partner thanks to

our quality service and proven track record.

title: Senior Backup Administrator – L3
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Backup Administrator (L3) to manage, support, and enhance enterprise backup and recovery infrastructure across physical, virtual, and cloud environments.

The role requires strong hands-on experience with Cohesity, Veritas NetBackup, Dell Data Domain, tape libraries, Azure Recovery Services Vaults, and SAN switches. The successful candidate will provide L3 support, troubleshoot critical backup issues, lead infrastructure upgrades and migrations, and support enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) activities.

Key Responsibilities

Backup Infrastructure Administration

  • Administer and support Cohesity and Veritas NetBackup environments.
  • Manage NetBackup Master Servers, Media Servers, and Media Appliances.
  • Manage Dell Data Domain backup storage and repositories.
  • Administer NBU Media Appliances and enterprise tape libraries, including IBM TS4300.
  • Manage backup environments across Windows, Linux, and Unix servers.
  • Build, deploy, and maintain backup infrastructure and repositories.
  • Support physical, virtual, and cloud-based backup environments.

Cohesity & NetBackup

  • Architect, deploy, and manage Cohesity clusters and NetBackup Master/Media Servers.
  • Configure and maintain backup policies protecting VMware vSphere, Nutanix, Microsoft SQL, Oracle databases, and large NAS environments.
  • Manage NetBackup Storage Lifecycle Policies (SLP) and Cohesity DataProtect policies.
  • Perform backup environment upgrades, patching, configuration changes, and lifecycle management.
  • Support migration from legacy tape and appliance-based environments to modernized Cohesity platforms.
  • Maintain high backup success rates and proactively address failed backup jobs.

Azure & Cloud Backup

  • Administer Azure Recovery Services Vaults using the Azure Portal.
  • Support backup and recovery for Azure workloads.
  • Provision and manage hybrid backup infrastructure targeting AWS and Azure environments.

SAN & Storage Administration

  • Configure and administer SAN switches, including IBM 48-port switches and IBM 24-port switches
  • Troubleshoot SAN, storage, tape, Data Domain, and backup infrastructure issues.

L3 Support & Troubleshooting

  • Act as the final internal escalation point for critical backup incidents.
  • Troubleshoot backup failures, performance bottlenecks, recovery issues, tape and storage failures.
  • Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring failures and critical production incidents.
  • Work with NetBackup, Cohesity, and other vendor support teams on complex technical escalations.
  • Coordinate with infrastructure, storage, network, database, virtualization, and application teams during major incidents.
  • Support Sev-1 incidents and critical production recovery activities.

Security, Patching & Vulnerability Management

  • Support vulnerability remediation across backup infrastructure.
  • Lead or support OS hardening, automated patching, firmware upgrades, and platform security activities.
  • Maintain secure configurations across Cohesity clusters, NetBackup appliances, and backup infrastructure.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise security and operational standards.

Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

  • Plan and execute enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) drills.
  • Validate backup recovery, failover, and failback procedures.
  • Document DR test results and recovery readiness.
  • Support recovery planning and continuous improvement of backup and DR capabilities.

Operations & Service Management

  • Follow established Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
  • Manage vendor engagement and ensure appropriate technical response and service levels.
  • Prepare operational and management reports.
  • Maintain technical documentation, procedures, and runbooks.
  • Participate in 24x7 on-call support as required.
  • Coach and support junior team members and peers.

Mandatory Technical Skills

  • Veritas NetBackup 11.x – Master Server & Media Server
  • NetBackup Media Appliance
  • Cohesity / Cohesity DataProtect
  • Dell Data Domain
  • Enterprise Tape Libraries – IBM TS4300
  • Azure Recovery Services Vaults
  • Azure Portal
  • SAN Switches – IBM 24-port / 48-port
  • Backup & Recovery Administration
  • Backup Policy & Storage Lifecycle Management
  • VMware vSphere / Nutanix
  • Microsoft SQL Server / Oracle Database backup
  • NAS backup
  • Windows / Linux / Unix environments
  • Backup troubleshooting and L3 production support
  • Disaster Recovery and failover/failback

Preferred Skills

  • Experience managing large-scale enterprise backup environments.
  • Experience with backup infrastructure migration and modernization.
  • Experience with AWS and Azure cloud environments.
  • Strong vendor management and escalation experience.
  • Experience with vulnerability remediation, OS hardening, patching, and firmware upgrades.
  • Strong RCA and major incident management experience.
  • Experience developing operational and management reports.

title: Senior Signal Integrity Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Signal Integrity Engineer based in Canada.

This is a senior engineering opportunity focused on advancing signal and power integrity solutions for next-generation, high-speed digital interfaces. You will work on advanced hardware systems supporting digital links operating at speeds of up to 448Gbps, combining electromagnetic simulation expertise with practical PCB design knowledge. The role involves analyzing cutting-edge PAM4 and NRZ interfaces, validating simulation results against real-world measurements, and developing robust design practices. You will collaborate closely with PCB layout engineers to optimize signal and power integrity across server, data center, and networking platforms. Your work will directly contribute to the reliability and performance of sophisticated electronic systems. The position also offers an opportunity to influence engineering standards through technical documentation, design guidelines, and best-practice development.

Accountabilities:

  • Conduct high-frequency electromagnetic simulations for next-generation 224Gbps and 448Gbps interfaces using tools such as Ansys HFSS and Keysight ADS.
  • Perform detailed Power Delivery Network (PDN) analysis using industry-standard simulation tools.
  • Analyze and validate high-speed digital links using PAM4 at 56Gbps and 112Gbps and NRZ at 25Gbps or higher, including eye diagrams, jitter, noise, and S-parameter analysis.
  • Correlate simulation results with measurement data to validate models, identify discrepancies, and improve design accuracy.
  • Develop, implement, and document best practices covering impedance control, transmission line design, PCB stack-ups, and practical PCB manufacturing constraints.
  • Create precise technical documentation covering simulation methodologies, findings, recommendations, and design considerations throughout the hardware development lifecycle.
  • Apply knowledge of high-speed Ethernet standards, including 25G, 100G, 400G, and 800G, to simulation and signal integrity analysis.
  • Collaborate with PCB layout engineers to evaluate and optimize board designs for signal and power integrity across server, data center, and networking hardware.
  • Contribute to actionable design guidelines for ultra-high-speed interconnects and advanced electronic systems.

    • Requirements

    • Minimum 5 years of direct, hands-on experience performing signal integrity simulations for high-speed digital systems.
    • Demonstrated proficiency with Ansys HFSS, Cadence Sigrity, PowerSI, Ansys SIwave, and Keysight ADS.
    • Strong expertise in high-speed digital interfaces, including PAM4 at 56Gbps and 112Gbps and NRZ at 25Gbps or higher.
    • Extensive knowledge of signal integrity and power integrity methodologies, PCB stack-up optimization, impedance control, transmission lines, and PCB fabrication/process constraints.
    • Strong understanding of electromagnetic simulation and high-speed interconnect analysis.
    • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to produce clear, comprehensive, and technically precise documentation.
    • A Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience, is preferred.
    • 8+ years of experience conducting end-to-end signal and power integrity analysis for high-performance electronic hardware is preferred.
    • Experience creating comprehensive design guidelines for ultra-high-speed interconnects and electronic systems is preferred.
    • Experience working directly with PCB fabrication vendors to implement and validate complex impedance-controlled board designs is preferred.
    • Strong collaboration and communication skills, particularly when working across engineering and hardware development teams.

title: Senior Data Engineer – AI
description:
You will operate across both fast-moving Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) engagements (POC/POV, pilot deployments for strategic and lighthouse clients) and steady-state system development and maintenance work — bringing the same rigor and a reusable, asset-fed approach to both.

Responsibilities:

Data Pipeline Engineering & AI-Readiness

• Design and build ingestion, cleaning, and transformation pipelines that turn messy, real-world client data into AI-ready datasets.

• Build batch and streaming pipelines (Airflow/Prefect/Kafka) that keep data flowing reliably into AI systems without manual intervention.

• Own data quality — deduplication, schema validation, completeness checks — upstream of any model or RAG pipeline.

• Proactively flag data gaps or quality issues that would degrade model/RAG performance downstream, before they surface as an AI Engineer's problem in testing.

RAG & Vector Store Architecture

• Architect document/data ingestion and indexing pipelines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems — chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid/vector search.

• Design and operate vector database and search infrastructure (pgvector/Pinecone/OpenSearch) at production scale and query volume.

Data Governance &Compliance

• Implement PII redaction, data residency, and access-control patterns aligned to PDPA and sector-specific requirements (Healthcare, Government, Transport).

• Maintain clear data lineage and metadata governance so engagement teams and auditors can trace how client data flows into AI outputs.

FDE &Development/Maintenance Coverage

• During FDE engagements: rapidly assess and prepare a client's data landscape during Discover/POC, identifying data-readiness gaps early.

• During system development & maintenance engagements: build and operate production-scale data pipelines handling the full volume and complexity of live client systems (e.g., Healthcare or Transport data at scale).

• Contribute reusable ingestion/indexing patterns back into the shared internal asset library to accelerate future engagements.

Collaboration &Leadership

• Partner closely and continuously with AI Engineers and AI Architects — understanding what a given model, RAG pipeline, or agent actually needs from the data layer and translating that into concrete pipeline and schema design decisions.

• Own the definition of "AI-ready" data for each engagement jointly with AI Engineers — agreeing on chunking strategy, metadata, freshness, and quality thresholds before pipelines are built, not after retrieval quality suffers.

• Sit in solution design conversations alongside AI Engineers and AI Architects, so data architecture and model/RAG architecture are designed together rather than data being treated as a downstream dependency.

• Mentor junior data engineers and set data engineering standards across engagements.

Requirements:

• 10+years in data engineering, including production-scale pipeline design (not just analytics/reporting pipelines).

• Strong SQL and at least one systems language (Python/Scala/Java); hands-on with batch and streaming frameworks (Airflow, Spark, Kafka).

• Experience building data pipelines for AI/ML or RAG use cases — embeddings, vector indexing, hybrid search.

• Solid understanding of data governance, PII handling, and access-control patterns in regulated environments.

• Comfortable moving between fast, exploratory data assessment (FDE/POC) and disciplined, high-volume production pipeline engineering (system development &maintenance).

• Working understanding of core AI/LLM concepts — tokenization, embeddings, chunking strategy, context windows, RAG, and agentic workflows — sufficient to hold areal technical conversation with AI Engineers and AI Architects about what "AI-ready" data means for a given use case, not just how to move and clean it.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate) and search platforms(OpenSearch/Azure AI Search).
