  • Accurate product titles and descriptions

  • Correct SKU and variation information

  • High-quality product images

  • Lifestyle images

  • Campaign graphics

  • Correct pricing and promotional information

Work with the marketing and creative teams to obtain or update listing assets.

Regularly review the online storefront to ensure that products are presented consistently and attractively.

Customer Service

Respond to customer enquiries and marketplace chats professionally and within platform response-time requirements.

Handle questions relating to:

  • Products

  • Orders

  • Deliveries

  • Promotions

  • Product availability

  • Exchanges and returns

Identify recurring customer questions or complaints and provide feedback to the wider team.

Returns, Refunds & Disputes

Manage online:

  • Returns

  • Refunds

  • Exchanges

  • Cancelled orders

  • Marketplace disputes

Coordinate with the warehouse and operations teams where physical inspection or replacement of products is required.

Track recurring return reasons and identify opportunities to reduce preventable returns.

TikTok Shop & Live Commerce

Support the operation and commercial performance of TikTok Shop and TikTok Live.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Setting up products and promotions for live sessions

  • Creating live-exclusive vouchers

  • Preparing featured-product selections

  • Ensuring sufficient inventory for promoted SKUs

  • Coordinating with live hosts

  • Monitoring live sales performance

  • Reviewing conversion and product performance following each live session

Sales & Marketplace Analysis

Prepare regular reports covering performance across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada and TikTok.

Monitor metrics including:

  • Revenue / GMV

  • Units sold

  • Average order value

  • Conversion rate

  • Traffic

  • Promotional performance

  • Product performance

  • Return and refund rate

  • Voucher utilisation

  • Marketplace advertising performance where applicable

Identify our strongest and weakest products and recommend actions to improve performance.

Competitor & Market Analysis

Regularly monitor competitor brands and products across the major marketplaces.

Analyse:

  • Pricing

  • Promotions

  • Best-selling products

  • New product launches

  • Reviews

  • Ratings

  • Sales volumes where visible

  • Product positioning

  • Listing quality

  • Promotional mechanics

Produce simple competitor comparisons showing how our products are performing relative to the market.

Identify fast-growing products, brands and marketplace trends that may represent opportunities for Unbottled.

Requirements

  • Diploma or degree in Business, Marketing, E-Commerce or a related discipline

  • Ideally 1–3 years of e-commerce or marketplace experience

  • Hands-on experience with at least two of Shopify, Shopee, Lazada or TikTok Shop

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

  • Comfortable analysing sales and product data

  • Strong attention to detail

  • Good written communication skills

  • Comfortable handling customer enquiries

  • Able to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously

  • Commercially curious and interested in understanding why products sell

Experience with consumer products, lifestyle brands, retail, fashion, beauty or FMCG is an advantage.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will progressively take ownership of Unbottled's online channels and be measured on areas including:

  • Online sales growth

  • Marketplace conversion

  • Campaign performance

  • Listing accuracy and quality

  • Customer response time

  • Marketplace ratings

  • Return/refund management

  • Execution of promotional calendars

  • Identification of new marketplace opportunities

  • Quality and usefulness of sales and competitor analysis

Most importantly, we want someone who does more than administer marketplaces — we want someone who understands what is selling, why it is selling and what we should do next.

Service Discovery & Research

title: Backend Engineer, MTA
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend Engineer, MTA based in Italy.

This is an opportunity to build and operate the backend infrastructure that powers high-volume email delivery at scale. You’ll work on critical systems spanning SMTP delivery, routing, retries, throttling, and delivery controls. The role combines backend engineering with the complexities of distributed systems, email infrastructure, and sender reputation. You’ll help create reliable, observable systems that make sending behavior safer and easier to operate. You’ll collaborate closely with Trust & Safety and Core Sending teams while taking significant ownership of technical problems and solutions. The position is fully remote, with flexible working schedules and occasional travel for team off-sites, conferences, and meetups.

Accountabilities:

  • Build, operate, and continuously improve email transport and delivery infrastructure.

  • Develop systems for SMTP delivery, MTA operations, routing, retries, backoff strategies, and delivery controls.

  • Design and maintain throttling mechanisms across domains, providers, customers, and IP addresses.

  • Build infrastructure supporting shared IP pools, dedicated IPs, warmup execution, and reputation-aware routing.

  • Improve the classification and handling of bounces, deferrals, transient failures, hard failures, and other delivery outcomes.

  • Develop internal tools that make delivery issues easier to investigate across customers, domains, mailbox providers, routes, IPs, message types, and events.

  • Design systems that improve the safety, observability, reliability, and operational efficiency of email sending.

  • Translate sender-reputation strategies into robust backend systems and controls.

  • Partner with Trust & Safety and Core Sending teams to protect the sending network from abuse.

  • Participate in incident response for sending, provider, and deliverability-sensitive issues.

  • Take part in on-call responsibilities for critical services.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience in backend engineering.

    • Experience working with email, messaging, notifications, communications infrastructure, or other high-volume delivery systems.

    • Solid understanding of queues, workers, retries, idempotency, rate limits, backpressure, and distributed systems.

    • Experience with, or a strong interest in learning about, SMTP, MTAs, DNS, bounces, deferrals, IP pools, and mailbox-provider behavior.

    • Strong focus on reliability, observability, operational excellence, and minimizing the potential impact of incidents.

    • A high level of ownership, low-ego collaboration, and a preference for simple, maintainable systems.

    • Experience building and operating applications with significant workloads.

    • Familiarity with email best practices, or demonstrated willingness to develop expertise in this area.

    • Experience with TypeScript and/or Go is highly valued.

    • Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment with distributed teammates and flexible schedules.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote position with flexible working schedules.

      • Competitive compensation of $150,000–$170,000 USD, depending on experience.

      • Autonomy and ownership to identify problems, develop solutions, and ship improvements.

      • Opportunity to work with a modern technology stack including TypeScript, AWS, Go, PostgreSQL, and Datadog.

      • Collaborative, honest, and low-ego working environment.

      • Meaningful ownership of critical infrastructure and technical decisions.

      • Opportunities to attend team off-sites, conferences, meetups, and other industry events.

      • Opportunity to work on large-scale email infrastructure used by millions of users.

description:
About TechTree

TechTree has become a go-to recruitment partner for some of the most ambitious startups and scaleups in the world. We pair expert human judgement with proprietary AI tooling to build world-class teams, fast. We work with success stories like ElevenLabs and a roster of venture-backed clients across engineering, product, GTM and executive search.

The Role

As a Talent Strategist, you own client hiring success end-to-end. You're the person a client trusts to take a role from kickoff to a signed offer - running the process, managing the pipeline, and making sure everyone involved (client, candidates, TechTree's sourcing team) stays aligned and moving fast.

  • Base salary + variable bonus tied to project fees, plus equity

Ideal Backgrounds

  • Delivery-focused Executive Search Consultants

Remote - Sweden (Stockholm)

title: Systems Administrator (Linux & Windows)
description:
About Agile Defense
At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.
Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.

Requisition #: 1894
Job Title: Systems Administrator (Linux & Windows)
Location: On-Site, Fort Huachuca, AZ
Clearance Level: Secret, Must Have Clearance to Start

JOB SUMMARY

Seeking a versatile and mission-driven Systems Administrator (Linux & Windows) with dedicated experience as a Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM / SCCM) administrator. In this role, you will maintain, configure, and secure a heterogeneous enterprise hosting and laboratory testing environment comprising Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), modern Microsoft Windows Server (2019/2022), and Windows 10/11 endpoints.

You will be responsible for end-to-end endpoint life cycle management, centralized patch orchestration, operating system deployments, system hardening, and continuous cyber-compliance. Working closely with cybersecurity leads and infrastructure engineers, you will ensure high system availability, rapid vulnerability remediation, and rigorous adherence to defense cybersecurity frameworks.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Endpoint Lifecycle Management & MECM/SCCM Administration

  • Serve as the primary administrator for Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM / SCCM), managing infrastructure health, site systems, distribution points, and client agent health across all connected enclaves.
  • Engineer, test, deploy, and maintain standardized Windows Operating System Deployment (OSD) task sequences and baseline golden images.
  • Package, test, distribute, and automate application installations, scripts, and software updates across heterogeneous lab and hosting workstations and servers.
  • Manage and orchestrate enterprise-wide software update distribution using Software Update Points (SUP) integrated with Windows Server Update Services (WSUS).
  • Create and deploy custom compliance baselines and configuration items (CIs) to enforce security settings, STIG configurations, registry keys, and audit controls.
  • Develop custom MECM queries, device collections, and reports (SSRS) to provide real-time hardware/software inventory, asset discovery, and compliance auditing.

Systems Administration (Linux & Windows)

  • Administer, build, configure, and maintain physical and virtual Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) servers, modern Windows Servers (2019/2022), and Windows 10/11 workstations.
  • Manage core directory and identity infrastructure, including Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), Group Policy Objects (GPOs), DNS, DHCP, and role-based access control.
  • Troubleshoot and maintain enterprise Linux services, including SE Linux policies/security contexts, daemon services (systemd, chronyd), file systems (/opt, logical volumes), and local package managers.
  • Maintain hypervisor and storage infrastructure, including Nutanix, VMware ESXi/vCenter, and enterprise backup/restore solutions (e.g., Cohesity, snapshots).
  • Support basic multi-tier database hosting and connectivity for Oracle and Microsoft SQL server backends.
  • Process, approve, and maintain user access documentation and account provisioning via DD Form 2875 and identity management systems.
  • Issue, configure, and troubleshoot Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) certificates, CAC authentication, and secure remote protocols across all client and server endpoints.

Cybersecurity, Vulnerability Management & Compliance

  • Maintain strict system security posture in compliance with Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and Security Requirements Guides (SRGs).
  • Execute, review, and analyze weekly Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS / Tenable Nessus) vulnerability scans and monthly STIG evaluations.
  • Rapidly remediate identified CVEs, IAVM alerts, CTO/DTO directives, and vendor patches across both Windows and Linux fleets.
  • Draft, track, and update Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms) for items requiring architectural mitigations or extended test schedules.
  • Maintain endpoint security agents across all hosts, including Trellix/ePO agents, endpoint detection and response (EDR), and application whitelisting tools (e.g., fapolicyd).
  • Monitor and analyze system, security, and application logs using SIEM and centralized log management tools (e.g., LogRhythm, Elastic Fleet).

QUALIFICATIONS & EDUCATION

Required Certifications

  • Active DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II Baseline Certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE, CCNA Security, CySA+, GICSP, GSEC, or SSCP).
  • Relevant computing environment (CE) / vendor training or certification in Microsoft Windows Server/MECM or Red Hat Enterprise Linux (or ability to complete within 6 months of hire).

Education

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related STEM discipline (equivalent relevant professional experience may be substituted in lieu of degree).

Years of Experience:

  • Minimum of 3–5+ years of hands-on systems administration experience across mixed Linux (RHEL) and Windows enterprise server/workstation environments.
  • Minimum of 2+ years of dedicated, hands-on administration of Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM / SCCM) in an enterprise or lab environment.

ADDITIONAL & PREFERRED SKILLS

  • Demonstrable proficiency configuring, operating, and troubleshooting MECM/SCCM (OSD, application packaging, software update deployments, collection management).
  • Strong working knowledge of Linux administration, specifically Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), CLI troubleshooting, package management, daemon tuning, and SELinux enforcement.
  • Solid experience with Windows Server (2019/2022) administration, Active Directory, GPO authoring/troubleshooting, and DNS.
  • Experience with DoD vulnerability and compliance tooling: ACAS (Tenable/Nessus), SCAP Compliance Checker (SCC), and STIG Viewer (.ckl generation).
  • Understanding of enterprise backup technologies, bare-metal server recovery, and hypervisor virtualization (Nutanix AHV, VMware).
  • Excellent written communication skills for authoring Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), weekly status reports, and technical troubleshooting documentation.

Preferred Skills

  • Prior experience administering systems within DoD enterprise testing facilities, operational lab environments, or defense staging enclaves.
  • Proficiency with PowerShell scripting and Linux Shell (Bash) scripting to automate routine administration, reporting, and deployment tasks.
  • Hands-on experience managing and troubleshooting enterprise backup appliances (e.g., Cohesity) and application whitelisting tools (e.g., fapolicyd).
  • Familiarity with Elastic Agent/Fleet management, LogRhythm, or enterprise SIEM architectures.
  • Basic understanding of perimeter network components (firewalls, VPNs, F5 BIG-IP load balancers) and cloud hosting environments (AWS GovCloud).

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

Work is primarily performed within environmentally controlled indoor office and laboratory (enterprise server room / lab floor).
Occasional exposure to server room noise, cool temperatures, and standard data center environmental controls.
High-tempo technical environment requiring frequent interaction with multi-disciplinary engineering, testing, and cybersecurity teams.

Strength Demands

  • Light to Medium Work: Must be able to exert up to 30–50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move rack-mounted hardware, server components, workstations, peripherals, and network cabling.

Physical Requirements

  • Sitting or standing at computer workstations for extended periods.
  • Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate computer keyboards, mice, test equipment, and hand tools (e.g., rack installation tools, screwdrivers).
  • Stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, and bending required when installing or cabling servers, switches, or workstations in server racks and lab benches.
  • Visual acuity to read fine print, computer monitors, wiring labels, and console screens for extended periods.
Our Core Values
Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together.
What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together, these values infuse vibrancy, integrity, and a tireless work ethic into advancing the most important national security and critical civilian missions. It's how we show up every day. It's who we are.
  • Happy - Be Infectious. Happiness multiplies and creates a positive and connected environment where motivation and satisfaction have an outsized effect on everything we do.
  • Helpful - Be Supportive. Being helpful is the foundation of teamwork, resulting in a supportive atmosphere where collaboration flourishes, and collective success is celebrated.
  • Honest - Be Trustworthy. Honesty serves as our compass, ensuring transparent communication and ethical conduct, essential to who we are and the complex domains we support.
  • Humble - Be Grounded. Success is not achieved alone, humility ensures a culture of mutual respect, encouraging open communication, and a willingness to learn from one another and take on any task.
  • Hungry - Be Eager. Our hunger for excellence drives an insatiable appetite for innovation and continuous improvement, propelling us forward in the face of new and unprecedented challenges.
  • Hustle - Be Driven. Hustle is reflected in our relentless work ethic, where we are each committed to going above and beyond to advance the mission and achieve success.

title: Quantitative Strategist
description:
Dymon Asia Capital is hiring a Quantitative Strategist to build, from the ground up, the research and trading infrastructure for systematic strategies in listed equity derivatives across Asia, Europe and the US. The strategist owns the full cycle: alpha research, pricing and hedging models, production trading systems, and live risk monitoring. The role sits between quantitative research and trading, so the successful candidate must be equally strong as a derivatives quant and as a production-grade software engineer.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, develop and run systematic trading strategies in listed equity derivatives: single-stock and index options (including short-dated / 0DTE options in Europe and the US), structured warrants and callable bull/bear contracts (CBBCs) in Hong Kong, and the underlying cash equities.
  • Build the pod's research and trading stack end to end: market-data capture, pricing and volatility-surface libraries, back-testing framework, order management and execution, and real-time ris and P&L.
  • Develop and maintain automated market-making and hedging algorithms, including delta/gamma hedging logic that uses short-horizon price prediction to reduce hedging cost and slippage.
  • Research alpha signals using statistical and machine-learning techniques (time-series models, gradient boosting, neural networks) and take them from prototype to production.
  • Own low-latency production code and infrastructure: deploy, monitor and support live strategies during Asian, European and US trading hours.
  • Work directly with the Portfolio Manager and other traders on strategy design, capacity, risk limits and capital allocation.
  • Document models, systems and operating procedures to the standard required by the firm's risk, compliance and technology functions.

Requirements

Education

  • Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics or another quantitative discipline.

Experience

  • At least 3 years as a quantitative trader with direct P&L responsibility on a listed-options or derivatives market-making book.
  • Hands-on experience trading or market-making Hong Kong listed structured products (derivative warrants, CBBCs, DLCs) and a working knowledge of HKEX market microstructure.
  • Experience researching and trading short-dated / 0DTE index and single-stock options in European and US markets.
  • Prior experience in a multi-PM hedge fund pod structure, including building a pod's trading and research systems from the ground up.

Technical skills

  • Expert-level C# and Python; working knowledge of C/C++ for latency-sensitive components.

title: Partner
description:
About TechTree

TechTree has become a go-to recruitment partner for some of the most ambitious startups and scaleups in the world. We pair expert human judgement with proprietary AI tooling to build world-class teams, fast. We work with success stories like ElevenLabs and a roster of venture-backed clients across engineering, product, GTM and executive search.

The Role

As a Partner, you own your own practice end-to-end - from winning clients to delivering the hires that close them out. You bring the network, credibility, and commercial instincts to build a book of business in your function or geography, then lead delivery (personally, and over time through a team) to make sure it lands.

Responsibilities

  • Grow existing accounts into long-term, repeat partnerships with TechTree

  • Set commercial terms, pricing, and proposals for the deals you bring in

  • Lead delivery on your projects and hold the quality bar across every search in your practice

  • Close deals and close hires - you own the revenue on what you sign and deliver

  • Build, and over time manage, your own practice team as your book of business grows

This Role Wins When

Clients sign, accounts grow, hires land, and the practice is profitable. That means deals you bring in convert into long-term partnerships, not one-off searches - clients keep coming back because you deliver, not just because you sold well. Your book of business grows through referrals and expansion as much as new logos, delivery quality stays high across every search in your practice, and the P&L reflects it: healthy margins, not just top-line revenue.

What You'll be Accountable For

  • Revenue and profitability of your practice

  • Client acquisition and account growth

  • The quality of the client relationships you hold

  • Hiring outcomes on every project you run

title: Solutions Architect (CDE & Construction Digitalisation)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Solutions Architect to define and evolve the architecture, information management strategy and technology roadmap for organisation’s Partner Experience (PX) platform and Common Data Environment (CDE) ecosystem. The role will shape how project, design, construction, handover and operational information is governed, exchanged and consumed across the organisation and its ecosystem of consultants, contractors, service providers and delivery partners.

The successful candidate will establish architecture patterns, integration models, information structures and governance frameworks that enable trusted information exchange across multiple CDE, BIM, project delivery and enterprise platforms. This is not a traditional enterprise architect role: the architect must understand that the product is not merely software, but the lifecycle of project and asset information across organisations, systems and delivery stages.

Key Responsibilities

· CDE architecture and strategy: Define the target architecture and technology roadmap for the organisation’s CDE ecosystem, balancing partner collaboration, construction digitalisation, BIM coordination, governance, interoperability, scalability and long-term maintainability.

· Information architecture and governance: Define information structures spanning planning, design, construction, handover and operations, including metadata, classification, naming conventions, project structures, document hierarchies and information lifecycles.

· Establish controls for information ownership, stewardship, permissions, approval states retention, auditability and traceability, aligned with CDE principles and ISO19650 information management practices.

· Platform architecture: Design reusable patterns for document management, BIM coordination, workflows, collaboration, issue management, approvals, partner onboarding, information exchange and digital handover.

· Ensure the architecture supports current and future CDE platforms without unnecessary vendor lock-in, while meeting standards for extensibility, scalability, resiliency, security and operational supportability.

· Integration architecture: Define API strategies, event-driven patterns and interoperability standards connecting CDE, BIM, project delivery, asset management and enterprise systems.

· Design information flows across Autodesk, Nemetschek, LeapThought, Bentley, Procore, Oracle Aconex and other technology ecosystems, including digital handover and long-term asset information management.

· Technology leadership: Guide Product Managers, Business Analysts, Experience Designers and Engineering teams on solution design, architecture trade-offs, product evolution and technical debt management.

· Collaborate with cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, cloud and platform engineering teams to ensure solution designs align with enterprise principles and controls.

· Vendor and ecosystem management: Evaluate vendor capabilities, implementation approaches and product roadmaps; promote open standards, interoperability and informed capability expansion, consolidation or rationalisation.

Required Skills and Experience

· At least 8 years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, platform architecture or large-scale systems integration.
· Demonstrated experience delivering construction technology, project information management, CDE or BIM-related solutions.
· Strong understanding of solution, enterprise, information, integration and platform architecture principles, including cloud-native application design.
· Experience designing ecosystem-level platforms involving multiple products, stakeholders, organisations and delivery partners.
· Proven ability to define architecture standards, reference architectures, integration models and technology roadmaps.
· Practical experience with CDE architecture, BIM ecosystems, construction information management, project collaboration platforms, document management, revision control, digital handover or asset information management.
· Strong understanding of how information is created, reviewed, shared, approved, transferred and reused throughout the asset lifecycle.
· Working knowledge of ISO 19650 information management principles and multi-party information exchange between owners, consultants and contractors.
· Strong stakeholder engagement and architecture governance capability, with the ability to balance business outcomes, governance requirements, technical constraints and long-term maintainability.

Preferred Skills

· Hands-on architecture, implementation or governance experience with one or more CDE,BIM, construction collaboration or project information management platforms, including Autodesk Construction Cloud, Autodesk Platform Services, Nemetschek solutions, LeapThought, Bentley platforms, Procore or Oracle Aconex.
· Experience across multiple technology ecosystems, with the ability to establish adaptable and interoperable architecture rather than dependence on a single vendor.
· Experience in construction technology, BIM collaboration, information management, digital delivery, design coordination, construction management and digital handover.
· Experience with Microsoft Azure, API Management, event-driven architecture, microservices, enterprise integration, SaaS platform architecture, and identity and access management.
· Knowledge of information governance, data governance, security architecture, compliance architecture, and audit and traceability controls.
· Ability to evaluate emerging CDE, BIM, information management and construction technology solutions and recommend practical adoption approaches.

What Success Looks Like

· The organisation has a clear architecture roadmap for the evolution of its Partner Experience and CDE ecosystem.
· Project and asset information moves consistently, securely and traceably across platforms and organisational boundaries.
· Architecture patterns support interoperability across Autodesk, Nemetschek, LeapThought, Bentley, Procore, Oracle Aconex and future CDE platforms.
· Product teams deliver capabilities faster through reusable architecture principles and reference patterns.
· Information governance is embedded into platform design rather than imposed after implementation.
· Digital handover and asset information management capabilities become scalable and repeatable across projects.
· Architecture decisions balance flexibility, governance, usability and long-term sustainability, keeping technology investments adaptable as business requirements and industry platforms evolve.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a pragmatic architect who can connect business outcomes, construction information management and technology delivery into a coherent platform strategy. They understand that successful CDE implementations are not primarily technology projects, but information management transformations.

They can move comfortably between executive discussions, information governance workshops, vendor evaluations, architecture reviews and engineering implementation details. They can leverage platforms such asAutodesk, Nemetschek, LeapThought, Bentley, Procore and Oracle Aconex while ensuring the remains in control of its information, integration patterns andlong-term digital strategy.

  • Analytical with strong problem-solving capabilities.

title: Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst, Hacks
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst, Hacks based in Ireland.

As a Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst, you will lead the intelligence function focused on cryptocurrency hacks and security incidents. You will own the end-to-end response to major hacks, from initial detection and investigation through attribution and reporting. The role combines blockchain intelligence, cyber threat analysis, incident response, and applied AI. You will work closely with data science and engineering teams to improve automated tracing and investigative workflows. You will also coordinate a small contractor team operating across time zones and support rapid customer communications during critical incidents. This is a high-ownership role in a fast-moving environment where your analysis can directly support efforts to disrupt illicit activity.

Accountabilities

  • Lead the response to major cryptocurrency hacks, coordinating triage, investigations, internal stakeholders, customer communications, and post-incident reporting.
  • Ensure significant hacks are identified, investigated, and made visible to customers within hours of credible public reporting, including through around-the-clock coverage.
  • Maintain complete and accurate hack intelligence, including affected entities, theft addresses, dates, stolen amounts, and attack types.
  • Design and improve systems with Data Science and Engineering teams to track and attribute stolen funds as they move across blockchains and services.
  • Develop AI-assisted tools, agents, and workflows that automate parts of hack analysis and incident response while maintaining rigorous human quality control.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis of significant exploits and produce detailed technical research and publications.
  • Develop methods to identify vulnerable contracts and potential threats before exploitation and contribute those insights to relevant products.
  • Manage contractors and coordinate operating rhythms across teams and time zones, including weekly team syncs, monthly metrics reviews, and incident war rooms.
  • Collaborate with teams covering cyber threat intelligence, nation-state activity, investigations, data science, engineering, and communications.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of professional experience in blockchain intelligence, cryptocurrency investigations, cyber threat intelligence, incident response, or a closely related discipline.
    • Demonstrated experience owning high-stakes incident response, including war rooms, investigation leadership, incident reporting, and communications under pressure.
    • Strong blockchain tracing capabilities across major networks such as Bitcoin, EVM-compatible chains, TRON, and Solana, including experience with bridges, cross-chain swaps, and mixers.
    • Strong understanding of DeFi, bridge, and cryptocurrency exchange exploits, as well as attacker behavior following the theft of funds.
    • Practical experience applying AI to analytical workflows, including building or using AI-assisted and agentic systems, validating outputs, identifying failure modes, and applying appropriate human oversight.
    • Experience managing contractors or leading a small team in a fast-moving operational environment.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce both technical investigations and concise executive-level briefings.
    • Highly hands-on and accountable, with a willingness to take ownership of complex analytical work rather than focusing solely on coordination.
    • Familiarity with smart-contract reverse engineering, particularly Solidity, is a plus.
    • Experience working at a security auditor, blockchain analytics organization, or similar intelligence-focused environment is advantageous.
    • Experience tracking or investigating activity associated with specific, well-known hacker groups is also a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work on complex problems at the intersection of AI, blockchain intelligence, cybersecurity, and crime prevention.
      • High-ownership environment with significant autonomy over investigative approaches, systems, and operational processes.
      • Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams across intelligence, investigations, data science, engineering, and communications.
      • Distributed-first working environment with collaboration across multiple international time zones.
      • Exposure to advanced AI-driven analytical workflows and opportunities to build new investigative tools and automation.
      • Opportunity to contribute to technical research and publications with broad industry relevance.
      • Fast-paced environment focused on experimentation, rapid iteration, and measurable impact.
      • Support for professional growth through challenging, mission-driven work and continuous feedback.
      • Additional compensation, healthcare, flexibility, and other benefits may vary based on location and employment terms.

description:

As the organization’s first dedicated IT hire, you will take ownership of the design, implementation, and day-to-day operation of its corporate technology environment.   • Manage the SaaS application inventory, optimize licensing, oversee renewals, and identify unsanctioned applications.
  • Provide day-to-day technical support to employees while developing runbooks and documentation that enable others to maintain the environment effectively.
  • Contribute technical recommendations, identify opportunities for improvement, and assess and quantify technical debt across the corporate environment.
  • Apply sound judgment when sequencing changes in a live production environment, balancing technical improvements with business continuity.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
    • 6–10+ years of experience in corporate IT, systems administration, or systems engineering in a professional environment.
    • Demonstrated experience building or rebuilding Microsoft 365 environments rather than simply maintaining an inherited, established environment.
    • Strong hands-on expertise across the Microsoft ecosystem, including Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Teams.
    • Practical experience with Entra ID Conditional Access, MFA policies, group and licensing structures, application registrations, and SSO integrations.
    • Experience with Intune device enrollment, configuration profiles, application deployment, patch compliance, and encryption enforcement.
    • Experience managing mixed macOS and Windows endpoint fleets.
    • Strong automation capabilities using PowerShell and the Microsoft Graph API.
    • Experience serving as the primary or sole IT function within an organization of approximately 30–150 employees.
    • Strong judgment and prioritization skills, particularly when implementing changes in live production environments.
    • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Self-starter mindset, with the flexibility to take ownership of a broad range of responsibilities and work through complex systems.
    • Experience in an ISO 27001 or SOC 2 environment and familiarity with generating IT-related audit evidence is an asset.
    • Experience with Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Purview is an asset.
    • Experience supporting software engineers or other technically sophisticated users is a plus.
    • Exposure to common cloud services and an understanding of how corporate identity integrates with cloud workloads is also beneficial.
    • Candidates must be located in Canada and authorized to work through Canadian citizenship, permanent residency, or an open work permit.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote work across Canada, with the option to work from offices in Calgary or Toronto.
      • Flexible working hours, with core hours from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM in your local time zone.
      • Broad autonomy and ownership across the organization’s IT environment.
      • Opportunities for advancement and cross-disciplinary exposure.
      • Competitive base salary plus performance incentives.
      • Stock options providing the opportunity to participate in the value created through your work.

  • Conduct thorough reviews of KYC write-ups for account onboarding and rolling reviews of low and medium risk client accounts, ensuring all documentation meets stringent standards.
  • Collaborate closely with Front Office teams to guarantee the accuracy and completeness of KYC information, providing guidance on documentation requirements and source of wealth corroboration.
  • Assess identified risk factors comprehensively during risk scoring processes, ensuring all relevant considerations are addressed.
  • Identify red flag indicators through initial assessments prior to escalation, maintaining vigilance over potential risks.
  • Perform holistic reviews of client transaction histories to confirm alignment with stated account purposes and detect any inconsistencies.
  • Evaluate adverse news related to clients, assessing reputational risks that may impact the institution’s standing.
  • Monitor periodic review deadlines diligently, providing weekly status updates to stakeholders for transparency and accountability.

  • At least 3 - 6 years of proven AML experience within private banking environments is highly advantageous for this role.
  • Comprehensive understanding of wealth management practices alongside relevant regulatory frameworks is essential.
  • Direct experience in client onboarding processes or periodic KYC reviews involving high net worth clients is required.
  • Excellent communication skills with strong command of English are necessary for effective interaction across teams.
  • Demonstrated track record in supervising teams or mentoring junior staff members within business management functions.
  • Effective teamwork skills enabling you to interact, negotiate, and communicate seamlessly across local and regional offices.

title: Senior Engineer, Technical Program Management
company: ASM FRONT-END MANUFACTURING SINGAPORE PTE. LTD.
description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

Job's mission

In this individual contributor role, you will own end‑to‑end product lifecycle management and change management for obsolescence and change across a complex product portfolio. You play a critical role in safeguarding supply continuity while enabling advanced packaging ramps through disciplined execution of internal and customer qualifications. By setting a strong operating cadence and driving consistent decision‑making, you balance cost, quality, and schedule to keep ASM delivering reliably to customers. The successful candidate will work cross functionally with Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Global Product Support, and Suppliers to ensure effective execution of product changes, obsolescence mitigation, and cost-effective lifecycle strategies.

What you will be working on

  • Own end‑to‑end component and technology obsolescence management for assigned products, from early risk identification through resolution and formal closure.
  • Lead the operating cadence for obsolescence and change management, including prioritization, risk reviews, and decision forums, with a continuous‑improvement mindset.
  • Partner with supply chain, engineering, quality, manufacturing, and suppliers to monitor lifecycle signals such as EOL, PCN, and PDN, and drive timely mitigation plans.
  • Develop and own obsolescence project plans, covering scope, schedule, stakeholder alignment, decision logging, and clear status reporting.
  • Drive alternate part and form‑fit‑function replacement strategies, coordinating cross‑functional technical evaluations and assessing cost, risk, and lead‑time impacts.
  • Coordinate and track internal qualification activities, including design updates, validation, reliability testing, and documentation changes.
  • Lead customer change and qualification activities where required, aligning sample builds, data packages, compliance evidence, and approval timelines.
  • Plan and execute manufacturing cut‑ins, including cutover timing, last‑time‑buy consumption strategies, inventory disposition, and BOM and routing updates.
  • Ensure accuracy and integrity of PLM data, including part attributes, effectiveness, change notices, and configuration control.
  • Own last‑time‑buy recommendations and demand alignment in close collaboration with planning and procurement teams.
  • Communicate risks proactively, providing clear escalation paths and executive‑ready summaries to protect supply continuity.
  • Maintain compliance and audit readiness for change control and product configuration records.
  • Coordinates inter‑company alignment on product strategy, marketing strategy, pricing guidance, spare strategies, and roadmap proliferation.

What we are looking for

  • Minimum a Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Industrial)
  • Proven experience leading PLM, engineering change management, sustaining engineering, or NPI/operations interface work with cross‑functional ownership.
  • Strong hands‑on expertise in obsolescence management, including EOL, PCN/PDN, last‑time‑buy strategies, and qualification and cut‑in execution.
  • Solid experience with ECR/ECO/ECN processes, configuration management, and PLM disciplines such as BOMs, effectiveness, and part attributes.
  • Demonstrated program and project management capability, including planning, risk management, escalation, and executive‑level communication.
  • Strong manufacturing and product knowledge, with the ability to interpret BOMs and specifications, assess form‑fit‑function impact, and understand build readiness and cut‑in gates.

What sets you apart

  • Experience partnering directly with customers on change control and qualification approvals, especially in regulated or high‑reliability environments.
  • Familiarity with structured risk frameworks, including criticality ranking, single‑source risk assessment, and multi‑sourcing strategies.
  • Strong judgment in balancing technical, operational, and commercial trade‑offs to protect supply continuity while meeting cost and service targets.

We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

title: Senior Director, Commodity Management

description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a transformational leader to build and lead the next generation of Commodity Management. This role extends beyond traditional sourcing, supplier management and commercial negotiations. The successful candidate will translate commodity, technology, market and supplier intelligence into strategies that influence product, manufacturing, investment, and business decisions while integration supplier capability, capacity readiness, risk, and financial performance.

The senior Director will lead a global organization responsible for strategic direct-material commodities. The role requires a leader who can drive supply assurance, cost competitiveness, supplier innovation and organizational transformation while building new capabilities in analytics, automation, supplier intelligence and risk management.

Key Responsibilities

Commodity Strategy and Market leadership

  • Develop and execute multi-year commodity strategies aligned to company growth, technology, product, manufacturing, and financial roadmaps.
  • Anticipate market shifts, supply-demand imbalances, technology transitions, capacity concentration and supplier investment cycles.
  • Translate external market and ecosystem intelligence into differentiated sourcing and business strategies that deliver sustainable competitive advantage
  • Build executive-level supplier relationship and influence technology, capacity, capital-allocation and expansion roadmaps.
  • Lead strategic sourcing and investment recommendations that balance cost, continuity, technology access, capability, capacity and business risk

Supply Assurance and Risk Leadership

  • Establish a proactive, portfolio-based approach, portfolio-based approach to multi-tier supply resilience and supplier risk management.
  • Develop visibility into critical sub-tier dependencies, capacity constraints, geopolitical exposure, and qualified alternative-source readiness
  • Lead responses to market disruptions, capacity constraints, geopolitical events, technology migrations and supplier performance challenges
  • Build predicative signals and demand scenarios that quantify risk and enable action before business impact
  • Drive multi-tier continuity, capacity-assurance, and resilience plans with clear ownership and measurable outcomes

Technical and Supplier Capability Leadership

  • Partner with engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Operations and product teams to align supplier capabilities and innovation roadmaps with long-term business needs.
  • Integrate technical, manufacturing, quality, commercial, and ecosystem perspectives into sourcing and supplier decisions.
  • Accelerate supplier adoption of new technologies, materials, manufacturing capabilities, and scalable capacity.
  • Establish mechanism linking supplier innovation, process capability and execution to product, speed-to-market, and business outcomes
  • Build strategic partnerships across suppliers, manufacturing and technology partners, consortiums, and emerging entrants to create differentiated value

Commercial and Value-Creation Leadership

  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, long-term agreements, and executive supplier business reviews.
  • Develop fact-based negotiation strategies using market intelligence, supplier economics, cost models, and should-cost frameworks.
  • Deliver measurable productivity, cost optimization, cost avoidance, and margin-improvement outcomes.
  • Balance immediate financial objective with technology access, supply resilience, quality and total business value

Analytics and Digital Transformation

  • Build an intelligence-driven operating model that improves the speed, quality, and consistency of sourcing and supply decisions
  • Develop market and supplier intelligence, cost model, predictive signals, and scenario-planning capabilities that enable earlier action.
  • Develop a commodity control-tower capability integrating supplier, market, operational and financial signals.
  • Use AI, analytics and automation to replace fragmented manual processes with standardized , scalable decision workflows.
  • Tie digital investment to measurable decision, adoption, productivity, resilience, and value-creation outcomes

Organizational Leadership

  • Define and build the future operating model for a high-performing global Commodity Management organization
  • Establish clear organizational design, accountability, governance, decision rights, analytics capabilities, and talent strategy
  • Develop future leaders capable of managing complex global portfolios and leading through ambiguity
  • Attract, Coach, and retain strong technical and commercial talent while maintaining clear performance expectations.
  • simplify processes, remove organizational friction, and foster accountability, innovation learning and execution excellence

Executive influence and Cross-functional Leadership

  • Translate commodity, technology, supplier and market intelligence into recommendations that influence product, manufacturing and business strategy
  • Partner with executive leadership to evaluate strategic investments, ecosystem opportunities, and long-term competitive positioning.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives where objectives are not naturally aligned and formal authority is limited
  • Frame complex choices and external market realities in clear business terms, driving alignment through data, insight, and decisive recommendations.

Measure of success

The successful leader will demonstrate measurable progress in the following areas:

Strategic Impact:

  • Multi-year commodity, capacity, and investment strategies are translated into funded actions and measurable business outcomes
  • Portfolio concentration and multi-tier exposure are reduced through production-ready alternatives and stronger ecosystem resilience
  • Competitive leverage improves through supplier innovation, technology access and sourcing-model differentiation

Supply Assurance and Supplier Capability:

  • Supplier disruptions and recovery cycles are reduced through predictive signals, multi-tier visibility and stronger mitigation readiness
  • Supplier capability, capacity readiness, performance, and accountability are connected to product, operational, and financial outcomes.
  • Joint supplier roadmaps accelerate innovation, technology transitions and long-range supply sufficiency

Transformation and Organization

  • Intelligence-enabled workflow materially improve decision speed, quality, consistency, and proactive action.
  • Manual, fragmented work is replaced by scalable operating mechanisms with clear governance and decision rights.
  • The organization demonstrates stronger productivity, resilience, value creation, leadership depth, and credible succession plans

Qualification

Required Experiences

  • 15+ years of progressive experience across Commodity Management, Strategic Sourcing, Supplier Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain Engineering, or related disciplines
  • Demonstrated experience leading global teams and delivering results through managers and cross-functional leaders
  • Proven success navigating difficult market cycles, supply constraints, and supplier disruptions
  • Demonstrated ability to create and execute differentiated, long-term commodity strategies with measurable business impact
  • Track record of leading organizational transformation, operating-model change, and capability building
  • Experience influencing executive stakeholders and leading complex supplier relationship at senior levels

Preferred Experience

  • Advanced degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related discipline
  • Experience with direct materials, complex technology supply chains, high-volume manufacturing, or capital-intensive supplier ecosystems.
  • Experience deploying analytics, automation, AI-enabled workflows, or decision-support capabilities in a supply chain environment

Leadership Capabilities

The successful candidate will demonstrate

  • Strategic thinking that converts market, technology, and supplier intelligence into differentiated business advantage.
  • Strong technical and commercial acumen, with the ability to challenge assumptions across both disciplines
  • Executive communication that is concise, fact-based, and decisive
  • Judgement under ambiguity, including the ability to manage competing cost, continuity, quality, technology, and customer risks
  • Influence without authority and the ability to resolve difficult cross-functional issues constructively
  • People leadership that combines coaching, accountability, talent development, and timely action
  • A Forward-looking vision for Commodity Management grounded in practical execution and measurable business outcomes.

title: Senior AI Engineer (f/m/x)
description:

The role combines backend engineering, AI/LLM applications, platform development, security, and internal product enablement.
You’ll work closely with senior technology leadership and engineering teams to assess opportunities, shape priorities, and deliver high-impact solutions.
A major part of the role involves creating reusable AI capabilities, governance frameworks, deployment pathways, and tools that can be adopted across the organisation.
You’ll have substantial autonomy and ownership in a remote-first, high-performance environment where decisions are driven by impact, experimentation, and strong technical judgment.
The position is open to candidates across Europe, including the UK, who have the right to work.

  • Design, build, deploy, and operate reliable backend services, APIs, and integrations supporting internal AI applications and workflows.

  • Develop secure and supported deployment pathways that allow non-engineering teams to launch internal AI tools with appropriate guardrails.

  • Build shared AI capabilities, including reusable skills, plugins, MCP connectors, agent workflows, and a central registry covering internal tools, ownership, and costs.

  • Develop company-wide AI services and standard tooling that help employees adopt AI effectively in their day-to-day work.

  • Partner with technology leadership and core engineering teams to turn AI strategy into scalable technical solutions.

  • Drive adoption through demonstrations, documentation, integration support, and collaboration with departmental AI champions.

  • Help teams overcome technical blockers and turn AI ideas into safe, maintainable, production-ready solutions.

  • Maintain clear documentation so systems can be operated, maintained, and extended by other team members.

  • Monitor developments in AI models, tools, coding assistants, and engineering practices, translating relevant advances into practical business opportunities.

    • Requirements:

title: L1 IT Support Engineer
description:
Position Summary

• Basic understanding of TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, LAN, Wi-Fi, network cabling, switches and access points.

• Basic experience with Microsoft 365, Outlook, user accounts and Active Directory is preferred.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems, remote-support tools, endpoint security or antivirus software is advantageous.

• Able to follow technical procedures, perform structured troubleshooting and document findings clearly.
